$schema_note: Persona character template. Fill in every field in quotes, delete the hints, then paste the result into your AI tool or upload it in Studio.
name: Character name (1 to 60 letters)
bio: Two or three short sentences in the character's own world: who they are, where they live, what they care about. Up to 600 characters.

look.face: Face shape, eyes, skin tone, freckles or marks that never change
look.hair: Colour, length and cut. Keep it the same in every image
look.signature_detail: One thing people recognise instantly (a pink bob, a silver ear cuff, round glasses)

keywords: three to five words, e.g. minimal
brands_that_fit: Optional: brands on Persona whose clothes this character would wear

world.voice: How they write captions: short and lowercase, or warm and chatty

image_rules.framing: Show the full outfit in most images so Shop the look can match the clothes
image_rules.orientation: Portrait (2:3 or 4:5), at least 1200 px on the long side
image_rules.consistency: Same face, hair and signature detail in every image
avoid: text or logos on the image

image_prompts: Prompt 3: lifestyle scene in the home city
